purpose: A public sample for testing the evaluation tooling (packets, measurement, the CLI). It is not a held-out set: it is open, fictional, and may be read and developed against like dev.
statement: Fictional cases written for this public sample: every report, publisher, place and company is invented (SYNTHETIC), and links use example.org. No case is taken or paraphrased from another set. Every label is provisional: the set author's judgement, not reviewed by an editor. Paired cases share a pair: similar words, different economic meaning. Nothing measured on this set says how a decision performs on real reports.

reports.title: Review: the new sourdough bakery on Elm Street is worth the queue
reports.excerpt: The loaves are crisp, the pastries sell out by ten, and the owner says she bakes through the night.

label.by: Claude Code (Claude Opus 5.5), the set's author; not reviewed by an editor
label.note: A neighbourhood shop review, no economic content.

reports.title: Flour mills raise prices 12% as wheat costs climb, bakers say
reports.excerpt: Two large mills told customers that flour will cost 12% more from December; bakers say bread prices will follow.

label.by: Claude Code (Claude Opus 5.5), the set's author; not reviewed by an editor
label.note: An input-cost change that passes into consumer prices.

reports.title: Photo app's latest patch fixes a crash when saving collages

label.by: Claude Code (Claude Opus 5.5), the set's author; not reviewed by an editor

reports.title: Blight spreads through potato patches in the north, growers say yields could halve

label.by: Claude Code (Claude Opus 5.5), the set's author; not reviewed by an editor
